newsitem.title: USA: U.S. spot jet prices bolt higher on NYMEX rally.
newsitem.headline: U.S. spot jet prices bolt higher on NYMEX rally.

text.p: U.S. jet fuel prices bolted almost two cents higher on Friday tracking a meteoric 1.99-cent gain in June heating oil futures, although activity was light as traders attended a variety of industry functions.
Aviation-quality 54-grade jet fuel was offered at 1.25 cents below June futures, stable with differentials late Thursday. An any-month parcel was sold for 1.15 cents below the screen, players said.
Gulf Coast diffs have hovered in a tight range for most of the week, between 1.25 cents and 0.75 cents below the screen.
